notes.title: Update details ver2.0.13
notes.notes: [p][b]Update details ver2.0.13[/b][/p][p]The following new features, game adjustments, and bug fixes have been added.[/p][p]- Made it possible to turn the display of game rules shown when entering a Death Poker game room ON or OFF in the settings.[/p][p]- The list of hands in Death Poker can now be displayed by pressing the “Hand List” button on the tablet located on the table.[/p]

notes.title: Update details ver2.0.12
notes.notes: [p][b]Update details ver2.0.12[/b][/p][p]The following new features, game adjustments, and bug fixes have been added.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue in Single Play where the game could not proceed to the next round after finishing the first round.[/p][p]- Adjusted the game rule display shown when entering a Death Poker room to make it easier for beginners to understand.[/p][p]- Hand list in Death Poker are now displayed at all times. You can toggle the display on or off using the “Hand List” button on the tablet.[/p]

notes.title: Update details ver2.0.11
notes.notes: [p][b]Update details ver2.0.11[/b][/p][p]The following new features, game adjustments, and bug fixes have been added.[/p][p]- The Summer Event has ended.[/p][p]- Updated the shop items.[/p][p]- Added new stash items: “Shisha” and “Shisha Cartridge.”[/p][p]- Added a new slot design to Death Slots.[/p][p]- Added a Stop button during Auto Spin in Death Slots.[/p][p]- The piano in the lobby is now playable.[/p][p]- Adjusted the betting system in Death Poker.[/p][p]- Added display for MAIN POT and SIDE POT in Death Poker.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where some objects would not appear in photos taken with the Toy Camera.[/p]

notes.title: Summer Event Extension
notes.notes: [p][b]Summer Event Extension[/b][/p][p]- Due to the popularity of the ongoing \[Summer Event], it will be extended until Aug 31 at 23:00 (PDT).[/p][p]- The purchasable items in the shop have been updated:[/p][p] Candy apples[/p][p] Cotton candy[/p][p] Frankfurter[/p][p] Fans[/p][p] Fox masks[/p][p] Hyottoko masks[/p][p] Hero masks[/p][p] Game Master mask[/p]

notes.title: アップデート内容 ver2.0.10
notes.notes: [p]Update details ver2.0.10[/p][p]The following new features, game adjustments, and bug fixes have been added.[/p][p]- Novice ranked players can now enter GAME ROOMS with default rules enabled.[/p][p]- When creating a GAME ROOM, you can now set player rank as a participation requirement.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update details ver2.0.9
notes.notes: [p][b]Update details ver2.0.9[/b][/p][p]The following new features, game adjustments, and bug fixes have been added.[/p][p]- The summer event has started.[/p][p]- The lobby appearance has been changed to a beach theme.[/p][p]- Updated props available for purchase:[/p][p]  Watermelon[/p][p]  Shaved Ice[/p][p]  Popcorn Machine Gun (Summer .Ver)[/p][p]  Spear Gun Ammo[/p][p]  Spear Gun[/p][p]  Wellington Sunglasses (Black)[/p][p]  Wellington Sunglasses (Green)[/p][p]  Wellington Sunglasses (Orange)[/p][p]  Wellington Sunglasses (Pink)[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that caused hand angles to be incorrect when other players entered the room.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where some models were not displayed when Evelyn was using the robot arm.[/p][p]- Improved the visibility of online statuses in the friend list.[/p][p]- Improved the visibility of locked/unlocked status in the lobby list.[/p]

notes.title: Update details ver2.0.8
notes.notes: [p]Update details ver2.0.8[/p][p]The following new features, game adjustments, and bug fixes have been added.[/p][p]- The 1st Anniversary event has ended.[/p][p]- The lobby has been changed to a regular model.[/p][p]- Shopping items were updated.[/p][p]- Added new stash item "MyPhone 16UltraMax".[/p][p]- Added a "Prevent snatching of items" option.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug with Midori's hand pose.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that caused items to be in different positions for different players.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that left a model in the air when eating a premium burger.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that prevented the grab operation after eating all the premium burgers.[/p][p]- Adjusted the position of the premium burger box.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that the player could enter the center area in the slot room.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where cigars would not shorten after being lit for a certain amount of time.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug in the SPACE ROOM where the player could not throw an item immediately after taking it out.[/p]
